# Summary

The charter states that each member pays a yearly contribution. The amount of this contribution is fixed in the annex of the charter [[cite:obs-f873e2806e1e18a0b23cfb2e2c77f923e19a5ec3 "Each member pays a yearly contribution; the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter."]].

According to the annex, the ordinary contributions amount to one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January [[cite:obs-afe418e50949d8d45a19b8e2ca648ce84645d131 "Ordinary contributions: one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January."]].
